name: mizan-sense-wsd
dataset_note: Derived weights only. The dataset itself (Q-CSMP v2) is NOT redistributed. Train = Q-CSMP v2 base train split with the 9 frozen label-noise merges (Amendment A1) + 24 targeted-mined interrogative أَيّ items (label_source=targeted-mining, real surah:ayah:word). Shipped sense_inventory.json is the original 115-sense inventory (required by the harness merge-map check); the bundle predicts the frozen 106-label space.
architecture: per-lemma sklearn LogisticRegression (lbfgs, C=1.0); char 2-4-gram surface+context features (variant 'a') + optional morph family (variant 'b'); single-sense lemmas use a constant prior predictor
